items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Chambers had booked the other band... We had given him his word that on our first day back in St. Louis, we'd be at his place.

ctx.x: We met and came back -- they all came back to go to work in September. And Mr. Chambers had booked the other band, and we had given him his word that on our first day back in St. Louis, we'd be at his place. That meant that the guys had to lay off. That meant that Jean and I had to go in our pockets to kind of finance the guys, to help them along through those three weeks. Those are the headaches you have when you have a big band.
That's a funny thing, too. And everybody came back, I guess, about $15, $20,000 overseas, that did it.
